title: Functions and settings that cannot be adjusted
summary: This topic centers on scattered complaints and unresolved remarks about functions, seat comfort, lighting, and other settings that users say cannot be adjusted, turned off, or dialed in as desired.

negative.summary: Negative reviews explicitly criticize functions that cannot be turned off and describe this limitation as undesirable for the vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a wide mix of inaccessible locations, hard-to-adjust seats, fixed lighting, loud minimum settings, and performance or comfort issues, but the fragment evidence is too varied or incomplete to summarize as a single clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic meaning is only weakly anchored by explicit sentiment.
The examples mix unrelated subjects such as software behavior, seat adjustment, ambient lighting, audio volume, navigation locations, and power feel rather than one coherent issue.
Several fragments are too brief or lack context to identify the exact feature or user outcome being discussed.
